subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix inbound image leaves agent turn unresolved; Matrix send queue hits fetch failed, then gateway reloads after ~60s

question: Should maintainers sponsor a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room reproduction before accepting or queueing a repair for this issue?
rationale: The issue has strong logs and source-aligned surfaces, but the combined encrypted image, Matrix SDK send queue `fetch failed`, active turn state, and gateway reload attribution cannot be settled safely from source-only review.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Use a Docker Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room setup to capture sanitized before/after logs, then repair the narrow Matrix delivery or restart-attribution path shown by that run.

options.title: Narrow with new reporter logs
options.body: Ask the reporter for one more current-main log bundle with Matrix verbose logging before deciding whether live QA is necessary.

options.title: Close only after non-repro proof
options.body: Close this only if current-main live repro no longer shows unresolved work, send queue failure, or gateway reload behavior.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Use a Docker Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room setup to capture sanitized before/after logs, then repair the narrow Matrix delivery or restart-attribution path shown by that run.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the current Matrix delivery replay behavior and recent inspected Matrix/gateway surfaces.
